items.name: tokens
items.title: CYBR//UI tokens
items.description: Opt-in colour, border, shadow, focus and motion tokens. Add @import "../styles/cybr-tokens.css"; after @import "tailwindcss"; in app/globals.css. Fonts fall back to Impact / ui-monospace unless --font-archivo-black and --font-jetbrains-mono are defined.

items.name: effects
items.title: CYBR//UI effects
items.description: Opt-in effect utilities (scanlines, grain, HUD corners, crosshair, hazard stripes, glitch, cursor blink, hazard march). Add @import "../styles/cybr-effects.css"; after the cybr-tokens import in app/globals.css. Every animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: React hook that reports prefers-reduced-motion. Static-first: returns true on the server and during hydration, so JS animation never starts before the real preference is known.

items.name: hard-offset-button
items.title: Hard-Offset Button
items.description: Signal-filled button with a solid offset shadow that steps in on hover and presses flush on click. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: glitch-button
items.title: Glitch Button
items.description: Outlined button whose label splits into RGB slices on hover, in short bursts. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: hud-bracket-button
items.title: HUD Bracket Button
items.description: Dark button framed by HUD corner brackets that snap out 5px on hover. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: terminal-button
items.title: Terminal Button
items.description: Terminal prompt button with a blinking block cursor that inverts to a signal fill on hover. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: hazard-button
items.title: Hazard Button
items.description: Destructive-action button framed in hazard stripes that march on hover. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: decrypt-text
items.title: Decrypt Text
items.description: Random glyphs that resolve left to right into the real string once on mount; screen readers get the real string. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: typewriter-terminal
items.title: Typewriter Terminal
items.description: Terminal panel that types its lines out once on mount, with optional prompt lines and a blinking block cursor. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: glitch-heading
items.title: Glitch Heading
items.description: Display heading that tears into signal and neon slices in a short burst every 3.2s, never continuously. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: telemetry-counter
items.title: Telemetry Counter
items.description: Tabular-figure number that counts up from 0 the first time it scrolls into view. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: stepped-wipe-reveal
items.title: Stepped Wipe Reveal
items.description: Block line that wipes in left to right on 12 hard steps the first time it scrolls into view, with an optional stagger delay. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Brutal Bento Grid
items.description: Hairline grid whose 2px gaps over a line-coloured parent become the borders. 1, 2 then 4 columns; cells span 1-4. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: stat-band
items.title: Stat Band
items.description: Signal-coloured ribbon of big numbers and mono labels, split by hard ground-deep rules that hold at any wrap. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: spec-card
items.title: Spec Card
items.description: Product card with a meta header and barcode, a big title, description, action link and spec list on a solid signal offset shadow. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: access-card
items.title: Access/ID Card
items.description: Ink ID badge with a hazard band, access level chip, photo slot, name, ID line and barcode. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: hardware-panel
items.title: Hardware Panel
items.description: Riveted surface panel with a cable channel and status rows that pair ON/OFF text with a signal LED. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: hud-image-frame
items.title: HUD Image Frame
items.description: Void-black media frame with signal corner brackets, a centre reticle, a static scan line, an outlined index numeral and a caption. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: neon-edge-card
items.title: Neon Edge Card
items.description: Link card whose border lights up in signal with a tight glow on hover and keyboard focus. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: classified-card
items.title: Classified Card
items.description: Dashed dossier frame with a rotated stamp and inline redaction bars that declassify on click. Visual only: never for real secrets. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: hud-tooltip
items.title: HUD Tooltip
items.description: Hover and focus tooltip in two looks: a bordered data readout and a target-lock card with bracket corners and a leader line. Built on Base UI. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: classified-accordion
items.title: Classified FAQ Accordion
items.description: Framed FAQ accordion with mono question rows, signal ids and +/− marks. One item open at a time by default. Built on Base UI. Requires @cybr/tokens.

items.name: ticker-marquee
items.title: Ticker Marquee
items.description: Signal band that scrolls its items endlessly, with hover, focus and button pause and a static reduced-motion state. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: warning-tape
items.title: Warning Tape
items.description: Tilted hazard-stripe tape with scrolling label chips, or a static stripe band without items. Pauses on hover, focus and button; static under reduced motion. Requires @cybr/tokens and @cybr/effects.

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: Logo Wall
items.description: Hairline grid of logo cells after a label cell, with signal hover on linked logos. One row from lg. Requires @cybr/tokens.
